decisions.method: Every residual path is either a specifically reviewed physical-device implementation outside the x86 SDK target, an architecture/KMI-only exclusion, or a generic symbol/tracepoint export. Physical-device path evidence includes configuration, driver selection and the SDK virtio hardware model; retain exact LTS implementations. For export-only paths, both normalized ACK versus common ancestor and port versus pinned LTS contain only export declarations, preserving native LTS function bodies. These exports retain source-level vendor customization without binary KMI promises; newly loaded trusted modules gain these entry points but no new userspace interface is introduced. No generic shared implementation is omitted based on a missing consumer. Identity paths have no residual ACK code. See evidence/generic-source-review.json and SECURITY.md. Merge resolution hunks are separately indexed.
